about_approach_step1_body: Umunyeshuri asuzuma ibyo akunda binyuze mu isuzuma rigufi kandi ryoroshye.
about_approach_step2_body: Guhuza byemejwe n'umwarimu bihuza umunyeshuri n'umujyanama wemejwe.
about_approach_step3_body: Umunyeshuri akurikirana iterambere kandi akabona amahirwe amureba.
about_approach_subtitle: Ibintu byose kuri Amahirwe bikurikiza igitekerezo kimwe cy'intambwe eshatu.
about_cta_body: Nyura mu nzira yose kuva ku isuzuma ry'impano kugeza ku mahirwe.
about_cta_title: Reba uko bikora, intambwe ku yindi.
about_hero_body: Amahirwe ni urubuga rwakorewe abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri ya Leta yo mu cyaro mu Rwanda kugira ngo bamenye impano zabo kandi bahurizwe n'abajyanama, abarimu n'amahirwe, rushingiye ku gitekerezo ko buri munyeshuri afite icyo azwiho.
about_hero_title: Gufasha abanyeshuri kumenya icyo bakora neza.
about_what_body1: Amahirwe ni urubuga rwa mudasobwa rufasha abanyeshuri kumenya ubushobozi bwabo binyuze mu isuzuma ryoroshye ry'impano rishobora gukorwa nta murandasi. Iyo agace k'impano k'umunyeshuri kamaze kugaragara, urubuga rushobora gutanga umujyanama wemejwe n'amahirwe (amaburusa, amarushanwa n'amahugurwa) bijyanye n'ako gace.
about_what_body2: Ntabwo ari isimbura ry'ishuri, kandi ntabwo ari porogaramu rusange yo kwiga kuri interineti. Intego yayo ni yihariye kandi ifite intego igaragara: guhindura impano y'umunyeshuri itazwi ikaba ikintu kizwi, gishyigikiwe, kandi gihuza n'intambwe ikurikira nyayo.
about_who_mentors_body: Abakorerabushake bemejwe batanga ubuyobozi mu murima wabo.
about_who_providers_body: Amashuri, imiryango itari iya Leta, n'imiryango bashyiraho amahirwe nyayo.
about_who_schools_body: Urufatiro rw'aho hafi rwiringirwa rushingira urubuga rwose.
about_who_students_body: Imyaka 12–19 bo mu mashuri ya Leta yo mu cyaro, bamenya ubushobozi bwabo.
about_who_subtitle: Amahirwe yashinzwe ishingiye ku matsinda atanu akorana hamwe.
about_who_teachers_body: Abantu bakuru biringirwa bemeza imyirondoro kandi bagasuzuma guhuza.
about_why_body1: Abanyeshuri bo mu mashuri yo mu cyaro akenshi bafite impano nyakuri mu byiciro nk'ikoranabuhanga, ubuhanzi, siporo cyangwa kuvuga imbere y'abantu, ariko bakagira amahirwe make yo kubona izo mpano zamenyekana, zikayoborwa, cyangwa zikahurizwa n'amahirwe. Ibikoresho biriho ahanini ni porogaramu rusange zo kwiga kuri interineti cyangwa serivisi z'akazi zibarizwa mu mijyi.
about_why_body2: Amahirwe yakozwe kugira ngo ikorane n'amashuri aho kuyanyuraho, itangira n'igeragezwa ryibanze mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda mbere yo gutekereza ku gukwirakwiza byinshi.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Andika email yawe, tuzakoherereza kode yo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga.
auth_google_role_subtitle: Konti yawe ya Google yahuye neza. Tubwire uri muri bo kugira ngo urangize kwiyandikisha.
auth_login_subtitle: Injira kugira ngo ukomeze kuri dashboard yawe.
auth_register_subtitle: Injira muri Amahirwe umenye impano yawe kandi ubone amahirwe.
auth_verify_dev_notice: Iyi ni verisiyo y'igerageza kandi nta serivisi ya email ihuye nayo, dore kode email nyayo yari kugira:
contact_confirm_body: Iyi ni porogaramu y'urugero, none nta kintu nyacyo cyoherejwe. Mu gukoresha nyako, itsinda ryacu ryagukurikiranira kuri imeli.
contact_form_notice: Iyi fomu ni igice cya porogaramu y'urugero ya Amahirwe kandi ntabwo yohereza ubutumwa nyabwo, ariko ni uko izasa igihe gukoresha itumanaho bizaba byubatswe.
contact_hero_body: Waba uri ishuri, umujyanama, cyangwa umuryango ufite amahirwe wifuza gusangiza, dore uko wadutumaho.
contact_schools_body: Ushaka kuzana Amahirwe ku ishuri ryawe?
dash_discover_talent_body: Subiza ibibazo bike maze tukwereke impano zawe za mbere.
dash_find_mentor_body: Tuzaguhuza n'umujyanama wemejwe mu bwoko bw'impano yawe ikomeye.
dash_mentor_need_profile_body: Tubwire akarere kawe n'ubwoko bw'impano ushobora kuyobora abanyeshuri.
dash_mentor_pending_verification: Konti yawe iracyategereje kwemezwa n'umuyobozi. Uzagaragara mu guhuzwa n'abanyeshuri iyo yemejwe.
dash_need_assessment_body: Duguhuza n'umujyanama ukurikije ubwoko bw'impano yawe ikomeye.
dash_need_profile_body: Dukeneye ishuri ryawe mbere yo gukora ikizamini.
dash_no_children_body: Saba mwarimu w'umwana wawe guhuza konti yawe kugira ngo ukurikirane iterambere rye.
dash_no_match_requests: Nta busabe bwo guhuzwa buhari kugeza ubu.
dash_no_opportunities: Nturaramanika amahirwe n'ayo ari yo yose.
dash_no_opportunities_found: Nta mahirwe ahuye ubu. Garuka vuba.
dash_provider_pending_verification: Konti yawe iracyategereje kwemezwa n'umuyobozi. Uzashobora kumanika amahirwe iyo yemejwe.
dash_schools_admin_subtitle: Suzuma amashuri abanyeshuri n'abarimu biyandikishirijeho ubwabo. Amashuri yemejwe agaragara ku rutonde rw'ishuri rwa bose.
dash_student_profile_body: Tubwire ishuri ryawe kugira ngo dutangire.
dash_sync_pending: Ibisubizo bimwe by'ikizamini birabitswe kuri iyi mudasobwa kandi ntibyoherejwe.
dash_teacher_need_school_body: Tubwire ishuri ryawe kugira ngo wongereho abanyeshuri kandi usuzume ubusabe bw'ubujyanama.
final_cta_body: Amahirwe yagenewe guhuza abanyeshuri, amashuri, abajyanama, n'abatanga amahirwe hamwe.
final_cta_title: Dufashe gushiraho inzira nyinshi z'impano z'urubyiruko.
footer_demo_notice: Iyi ni porogaramu y'urugero yakozwe mu mashuri makuru. Ibiri kuri uru rubuga n'amahirwe agaragara ni ingero, si ibisubizo nyabyo.
footer_rights: © 2026 Amahirwe. Yakorewe abanyeshuri bo mu Rwanda.
hero_subtitle: Amahirwe ifasha abanyeshuri kumenya ubushobozi bwabo, bakahurizwa n'abajyanama (mentors) beemejwe, kandi bakabona amahirwe abafasha gukura.
hiw_cta_body: Reba uko intambwe ya mbere (Menya) isa mu by'ukuri.
hiw_hero_body: Uburyo bugaragaza intambwe ku yindi ibintu bibera kuri Amahirwe, byateguwe kugira ngo byorohe gukurikirana, nubwo aya ari amakuru wumva bwa mbere kuri uru rubuga.
hiw_hero_title: Kuva ku isuzuma ry'impano kugeza ku mahirwe nyayo.
hiw_intro_body: Buri gice cya Amahirwe cyabayeho kugira ngo cyimurire umunyeshuri muri iyi nzira mu mutekano, ku muvuduko we bwite, kandi nta murandasi uhoraho ukenewe kugira ngo atangire.
hiw_intro_title: Intambwe esita, umunyeshuri umwe ku wundi.
hiw_safety_body: Umujyanama ntabwo ahabwa amakuru yo kuvugana n'umunyeshuri nta kwemezwa n'umwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi mbere. Kubera ko abakoresha ba mbere ba Amahirwe ari abana bato, iyi ntambwe ntisimburwa na rimwe.
hiw_step1_body: Umunyeshuri arangiza isuzuma rigufi ry'impano (rivanze n'inyandiko, amashusho, n'amajwi bishoboka) rikora nta murandasi na hato.
hiw_step2_body: Umwirondoro w'ibanze urashyirwaho ushingiye ku byo umunyeshuri akunda n'ubushobozi bwe, utangizwa n'umunyeshuri ubwe cyangwa, niba afite isoni, n'umwarimu umugenzura.
hiw_step3_body: Amahirwe imenya abajyanama bashobora kuba babereye, bavuye mu itsinda ryemejwe, ikoresheje uburyo bworoshye kandi busobanutse bwo guhuza bushingiye ku gace k'impano n'ururimi.
hiw_step4_body: Umwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi asuzuma guhuza n'umujyanama byatanzwe mbere y'uko ikindi cyose gikomeza.
hiw_step5_body: Iyo byemejwe, guhuza n'umujyanama birashyirwaho, kandi umujyanama n'umwarimu w'umunyeshuri bombi bakamenyeshwa.
hiw_step6_body: Umunyeshuri abona amahirwe ajyanye n'agace k'impano ye kandi agakurikirana iterambere n'ibimenyetso by'intsinzi mu gihe.
how_it_works_subtitle: Intambwe eshatu zoroshye, zikora n'igihe nta murandasi uhari.
impact1_body: Gufasha abanyeshuri kumenya ubushobozi bashobora kuba bataziko bafite.
impact2_body: Gushiraho imikoranire igenzuwe hagati y'abanyeshuri n'abajyanama biringiwe.
impact3_body: Gutuma amaburusa, amarushanwa, amahugurwa n'andi mahirwe aboneka byoroshye.
impact4_body: Guha abarimu ubushobozi bwo kubona neza iterambere ry'abanyeshuri n'aho hakenewe ubufasha.
impact_community1_body: Guhuza urubyiruko n'abanyamwuga bo mu baturage babo hafi.
impact_community2_body: Gutuma amaburusa na porogaramu ziriho by'ukuri zigaragara neza.
impact_cta_body: Waba uri ishuri, umujyanama, cyangwa utanga amahirwe, hari uburyo bwo kwifatanya.
impact_cta_title: Dufashe iri geragezwa ribe ikintu gikwiye gukwirakwizwa.
impact_hero_body: Amahirwe ni porogaramu y'igerageza: iyi paji isobanura ibyo yagenewe kugeraho, ntabwo ari ibyavuye mu byo yamaze gukora.
impact_longterm_body: Amahirwe itangira n'igeragezwa ryibanze mu mashuri ya Leta yo mu cyaro mu Ntara y'Iburasirazuba y'u Rwanda. Inyandiko y'ibisabwa (SRS) y'uru rubuga isobanura imiterere ishobora gukwirakwira kurenga iryo geragezwa rya mbere: intego y'igihe kirekire y'umuryango ALCHE ni ukubaka urugero rushobora kuzakwirakwira muri Afurika yose. Ubwo bukwirakwire ntibwaragera; ni yo nzira porogaramu yateguwe gushyigikira.
impact_school1_body: Ubushobozi bwo kubona neza ibyo abanyeshuri bakunda n'aho ubushake bwabo bugaragarira.
impact_school2_body: Uburyo bugaragara bwo kumenya abanyeshuri bashobora gukeneye gushishikarizwa.
impact_school3_body: Ikiraro cyoroshye hagati y'ishuri n'abajyanama n'abatanga amahirwe bo hanze.
impact_student1_body: Abanyeshuri benshi bamenya ubushobozi bashobora kuba batari barabwise izina mbere.
impact_student2_body: Kubona byoroshye amaburusa, amarushanwa n'amahugurwa mu gace k'impano yabo.
impact_student3_body: Inzira igenzuwe kandi yemejwe yo kubona ubuyobozi buva ku muntu ugeze kure mu nzira isa n'iyabo.
impact_subtitle: Amahirwe ni porogaramu y'igerageza. Dore ibyo yagenewe kugeraho.
journey_future_desc: Ifungura amarembo ku burezi bukomeje n'imirimo nyayo.
journey_growth_desc: Ateza imbere ubumenyi n'icyizere hamwe n'ubufasha buhoraho bw'umujyanama.
journey_mentor_desc: Ahuzwa n'umujyanama wemejwe, byemejwe n'umwarimu we.
journey_opportunity_desc: Abona amabuku y'ubufasha n'amahirwe y'akazi ahuye n'impano ye.
journey_talent_desc: Arangiza ikizamini cy'impano akabona impano ze z'ingenzi.
mentors_confidence_body: Shishikariza abanyeshuri kwizera ko ibyo bakunda bishobora guhinduka ubumenyi nyabwo.
mentors_cta_body: Iyandikishe kandi urangize inzira yo kugenzurwa kugira ngo utangire.
mentors_explore_body: Fasha urubyiruko gusobanukirwa imirimo itandukanye n'amahirwe abafungukiye.
mentors_giveback_body: Shyigikira abanyeshuri bo mu gisekuru gikurikira bakora ku nzira yabo bwite.
mentors_hero_body: Ubujyanama kuri Amahirwe ni umurimo woroshye kandi ugenzuwe, ntabwo ari uw'igihe kitagira iherezo. Dore icyo bisobanura by'ukuri.
mentors_hero_title: Ubunararibonye bwawe bushobora gufasha guhindura intambwe ikurikira y'undi muntu.
mentors_how_body: Nyuma yo kwiyandikisha, abajyanama banyura mu ntambwe yo kugenzurwa n'umuyobozi. Iyo bemejwe, umujyanama ashobora gutangwa ku munyeshuri hashingiwe ku guhuza koroshye kw'agace k'impano n'ururimi. Ubwo buhuza bukiri bukeneye kwemezwa n'umwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi mbere y'uko bukora. Abajyanama ntibashakisha abanyeshuri, kandi abanyeshuri ntibashakisha abajyanama ubwabo.
mentors_matter_title: Guhuzwa n'umuntu umwe bishobora gufungura inzira nshya.
mentors_safeguards_intro: Kubera ko abanyeshuri ba Amahirwe ari abana bato, ubujyanama bwashinzwe ku ngamba z'umutekano kuva mu ntangiriro:
mentors_safeguards_li1: Abajyanama bategerejwe kugenzurwa n'umuyobozi mbere y'uko bagaragara mu buhuza ubwo ari bwo bwose.
mentors_safeguards_li2: Buri guhuza n'umujyanama gusaba kwemezwa n'umwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi mbere y'uko gukora.
mentors_safeguards_li3: Abanyeshuri ntibahabwa uburenganzira bwo kuvugana n'abajyanama bidasuzumwa.
mentors_share_body: Abajyanama bazana ubunararibonye abanyeshuri badafite mu bidukikije byabo bya hafi.
mission_believe1_body: Impano ntabwo ari iy'agasusuruko; amahirwe yo kuyimenyekanisha no kuyishyigikira ni yo make.
mission_believe2_body: Amaburusa, amarushanwa n'amahugurwa ntibigomba gushingira ku bantu uzi.
mission_believe3_body: Abarimu akenshi ni bo bafite umwanya mwiza wo kumenya ubushobozi bw'umunyeshuri no kubuhamya.
mission_believe4_body: Ikiganiro n'umuntu ugeze kure mu nzira runaka gishobora guhindura uko umunyeshuri abona amahitamo ye.
mission_believe5_body: Rikoreshejwe neza, kandi rikozwe kugira ngo rikore n'aho murandasi idahoraho, rishobora kugera ku banyeshuri ibindi bikoresho bitagera.
mission_believe5_title: Ikoranabuhanga rishobora gufasha guhuza icyuho cy'amahirwe.
mission_cta_body: Menya ikibazo Amahirwe igerageza gukemura n'abo ikorera.
mission_cta_title: Soma byinshi ku ho iyi ntego yaturutse.
mission_goal1_body: Guha abanyeshuri benshi uburyo bworoshye bwo kumenya ubushobozi bwabo, nubwo nta murandasi uhamye uhari.
mission_goal2_body: Guhuza abanyeshuri n'abajyanama bemejwe, umwarimu cyangwa umuyobozi akemeza buri guhuza.
mission_goal3_body: Kugaragaza amaburusa, amarushanwa, amahugurwa n'amasomo bijyanye n'agace k'impano ka buri munyeshuri.
mission_goal4_body: Guha abarimu ubushobozi bwo kumenya abanyeshuri bagize uruhare, n'abakeneye gusunikwa gato.
mission_goal4_title: Gufasha abarimu kumenya abanyeshuri bakeneye gushishikarizwa
mission_goal5_body: Gutangira n'igeragezwa ryibanze mu Rwanda, hakoreshejwe imiterere yateguwe gukura kurenga aho.
mission_goal5_title: Kubaka urugero rushobora gukura mu gihe
mission_goals_subtitle: Ibyo iyi ntambwe ya mbere ya Amahirwe igamije kugeraho.
mission_hero_body: Gufasha urubyiruko kumenya ubushobozi bwabo no kubuhuza n'abantu, ibikoresho n'amahirwe.
mission_hero_title: Guhindura ubushobozi mu ntambwe nyayo ikurikira.
mission_vision_body: Ejo hazaza aho impano itagenwa n'aho umuntu mutoya akuriye, aho aho umunyeshuri aba cyangwa imimerere ye bitagena niba ubushobozi bwe buzamenyekana kandi bugashyigikirwa.
not_found_body: Ihuza rishobora kuba ryarangiritse, cyangwa iyi paji yashobora kuba yimuwe. Reka tuguhe uburyo bwo kugaruka ahantu nyaho.
offline_message: Nta murandasi ufite. Ibyo wakoze bibitswe kuri iyi telefone kandi bizohererezwa iyo ugarutse kuri murandasi.
opp2_title: Ifashishwa ry'Uburusa bw'Impano zo mu Cyaro
opp3_title: Uburambe bwo Kuvuga Inkuru kuri Radiyo y'Umuryango
opp_cta_body: Fatanya na Amahirwe utange amaburusa, amarushanwa, uburambe cyangwa amahugurwa.
opp_demo_body: Amakarita ari hejuru ni ingero zitari nyazo zikoreshwa mu kwerekana uko urutonde rw'amahirwe rukora. Amahirwe nyayo kuri Amahirwe atangwa n'abatanga amahirwe bemejwe kandi agasuzumwa mbere yo gutangazwa.
opp_examples_subtitle: Izi ni ingero zitari nyazo zigaragaza ubwoko bw'amahirwe urubuga rwateguwe kwerekana.
opp_hero_body: Amahirwe ihuza amaburusa, amarushanwa, uburambe (stage), n'amahugurwa, byatanzwe n'abatanga amahirwe bemejwe kandi bikurikije agace k'impano, kugira ngo abanyeshuri batabishakisha bonyine.
schools_cta_body: Turi kubaka iri geragezwa n'umubare muto w'amashuri. Duhamagare kugira ngo umenye byinshi.
schools_cta_title: Ushaka kuzana Amahirwe ku ishuri ryawe?
schools_do_li3: Kwifuza abanyeshuri bashobora kugira isoni yo kwiyandikisha ubwabo
schools_do_li4: Gusuzuma guhuza n'abajyanama mbere y'uko habaho kuvugana ikindi cyose
schools_hero_body: Gufasha abanyeshuri bitangirira ku kumenya ubushobozi bwabo. Amahirwe ikorana n'amashuri nk'ikiraro cy'ingenzi hagati y'abanyeshuri, abajyanama, n'amahirwe.
schools_intro: Amahirwe ikorana n'amashuri nk'ikiraro cy'ingenzi hagati y'abanyeshuri, abajyanama, n'amahirwe.
schools_leaders_body: Kurenga ibyumba by'amasomo ku giti cyabyo, Amahirwe yateguwe kugira ngo ihe abayobozi b'amashuri ubushobozi bwo kubona neza aho ibyo abanyeshuri bakunda bigarukira, uko ubushake bwabo bugenda buhinduka, n'amahirwe yo hanze bahurizwa nayo, nta guhinduka porogaramu igoye yo gutanga raporo.
schools_participate1_body: Ishuri riyandikisha kugira ngo rigire uruhare mu igeragezwa.
schools_participate2_body: Abarimu bafasha abanyeshuri kuzuza imyirondoro no gusuzuma guhuza.
schools_participate3_body: Abanyeshuri bakora isuzuma, bakahuzwa kandi bagasuzuma amahirwe.
schools_teachers_body: Dashboard y'umwarimu yashinzwe ishingiye ku kibazo kimwe: ni ba nde abanyeshuri bakeneye kwitabwaho ubu? Igaragaza, mu kanya gato, uwarangije umwirondoro, uwafite guhuza n'umujyanama gitegereje kwemezwa, n'uwakenera gusunikwa gato kugira ngo arangize isuzuma ry'impano, nta gushyingurwa mu bikubiyemo byinshi.
step_connect_body: Abanyeshuri bashobora guhurizwa n'abajyanama babareba, binyuze mu buryo bwo guhuza busuzumwa n'abarimu.
step_discover_body: Abanyeshuri bakora isuzuma ryoroshye ry'impano kugira ngo bamenye ibyo bakunda n'ubushobozi bwabo.
step_grow_body: Abanyeshuri babona amahirwe kandi bakomeza kwiteza imbere mu bumenyi n'ibyo bagezeho.
who_schools_body: Fasha abanyeshuri kandi umenye impano zibashya.
who_subtitle: Urubuga rusangiwe n'abose bagira uruhare mu iterambere ry'umunyeshuri.
why_body: Abanyeshuri benshi bafite impano n'ibyo bakunda ariko ntibigera bamenyekana cyangwa bagahurizwa n'amahirwe, cyane cyane mu mashuri afite ibikoresho bike. Amahirwe yakozwe kugira ngo ifashe guhuza ibyo bintu bishoboke.
